title: Structured Identity v1.1 Milestone 2A SPK baseline run
note: This node records the approved Milestone 2A validation/baseline run. It is not authorization for nonlinear flat, structured, ablation, architecture-search, or broad hyperparameter experiments.

claims.statement: The corrected readiness-gated Milestone 2A run processed the frozen five-session primary corpus across three subjects, produced 60 successful session-area-representation cells, 9548 held-out predictions, 166 fold-diagnostic rows, and 60000 grouped null draws with seed 42 and 1000 permutations per cell.

The repaired presented-identity positive-control machinery had valid grouped folds and successful feature/model execution in all five primary sessions; the receipt records positive_control_data_gate=true and no run errors. Cell-level positive-control performance is heterogeneous and is retained for review rather than compressed into a single biological claim.

Across the 15 successful omission-reversal cells per representation, the descriptive mean G_balanced was 0.040157 for R0 and -0.068613 for R1. Session and area effects vary in sign, so these fold/cell summaries are not independent biological replicates and do not by themselves establish expected-identity generalization.

The primary null permutes labels within common-cycle-by-slot groups using jnwb.permutation.permute_labels, preserves p4 expected/previous complementarity, keeps outer folds fixed, and freezes observed-fold regularization choices instead of repeating post hoc selection under the null.

Only R0 and R1 regularized linear baselines and the presented positive control were run. No nonlinear flat M2, structured M3, structure-ablation M4, architecture search, or broad hyperparameter search was performed.

issues: The primary corpus contains only five sessions across three subjects; fold-level results remain nested repeated measurements, not independent biological replicates.
Positive-control performance is heterogeneous across session and area; the data-extraction gate passed, but scientific adequacy requires Sol/Hamm review.
The run uses NWB unit spike trains with quality_filter=null and no LFP/MUAe path; signal scope is explicit in the receipt.
No Figure 04 regeneration or manuscript/Labyrinth claim upgrade is authorized from this receipt alone.

verification.verdict: milestone_2a_complete; review positive-control adequacy and reversal diagnostics; keep SAFE_TO_TRAIN_M2_M3=NO

falsifier: This receipt is superseded if the frozen five-session corpus, grouped/null contract, estimator contract, or sign convention changes, if a rerun does not reproduce the recorded output hashes, or if Sol/Hamm review rejects the baseline implementation.
